name: growthnation
description: The GrowthNation MCP connector — plug your agent into your company's Agentic Transformation OS. Sign in once (OAuth) and your agent gets your department's AI skill library as tools: skills generated from voice interviews with your actual team, security-audited, quality-scored, versioned, and served fork-first (your personal version when you have one, the team's otherwise). It also routes your company's connected tools — Google Workspace (Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs, Slides, Forms, Ads, Gmail), Slack, Notion, GitHub, Asana, Apollo, Fireflies, Fathom, Granola and more — through one gateway with credentials held server-side. Built-in tools: start-interview (feed your department's library with a voice interview), department-audit (your interview-grounded AI-readiness scorecard), create-skill (propose a skill to the company library), report-feedback (a misbehaving skill regenerates within ~2 minutes). No API keys — just sign in.
